notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Emeria Angel, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
The Bird enters the battlefield as a Saproling due to Maskwood Nexus, which also causes it to be a Forest land due to Life and Limb.
Emeria Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
